text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Curren~!!
Can I take a picture with you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa! Curren~~!!
Please give me your autograph!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, if you're okay with Curren's autograph!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Curren~!!
Your Umastagram post this morning was super cute too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ufu, thanks for watching!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then Curren Chan appeared on the training track,
but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ready, and! Curren~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeees♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems Curren Chan's fans have gathered
especially close to the course today."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ? Curren is doing great, you know?
choice_data_list: ...Do you think you'll be able to focus too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, so that's what it is~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then Curren's answer
is gonna be "Of course!"♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"The cheers seem just a teeeeny bit louder
than usual today, though—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Having people around who support me makes me super happy♪ Curren's totally fine, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So don't worry...
Just keep your eyes only on Curren, okay, Onii-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So don't worry...
Just keep your eyes only on Curren, okay, Onee-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Curren～～！！

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: Show me a sharp run, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: Show me a sharp run, okay!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ufu, hearing you expect so much from me makes Curren sooo happy♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, if I run a great race,
you have to give Curren loooots of praise, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa~! Curreââ

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SWOOSH――!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan dashes forward at a speed
that seems to slice through the very sounds around her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehe. How was it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay♪ Big brother,
praise Curren more and more~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay♪ Big sister,
praise Curren more and more~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah! So cuuute!
Cute Curren-chan~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan demonstrated
incredible focus and speed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Geez, what a worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it just means you care about Curren
that much, right?
Curren knows that, you know.”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chan~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Smoothly—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan quietly raised her hand high.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dead silence...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Let's ask them to cheer with the volume turned down today♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, my fans will understand too.
After all, they love Curren so, so much☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer beauty of her leadership drew words from my lips unbidden.
"Amazing... Curren Chan..."
